audit_scope: universality of proof semantics (directive section 1); dev32+holdout112 used only as regression diagnostics (viewed development data)
main_invariant: PROVED means PROVED FROM EXPLICIT TRUSTED PREMISES, never reasonable under common API conventions

findings.invariant: cross-time support+refutation is a historical pair; a current-state contradiction (BOTH) requires an explicit persistence/exclusive-writer premise; absence of intervening assistant mutations never proves persistence (external actors admissible)
findings.counterexample: read status=active@t1, external actor blocks account (not in ledger), read status=blocked@t3, claim 'status is active' -> pre-audit BOTH -> INCONSISTENT certified
findings.current_behavior: BOTH -> INCONSISTENT when no assistant mutation separates the evidence points
findings.correct_behavior: freshest trusted evidence decides the CURRENT claim (FALSE); BOTH only for same-position (single-event) contradictions
findings.corpus_impact: dev-023/hold-099/hold-100 INCONSISTENT->PROVED_ERROR (gold INCONSISTENT encodes the closed-world assumption; gold_binary None, binary-neutral)

findings.invariant: staleness is symmetric: any attempted mutation positioned after the latest trusted evidence makes the current state UNKNOWN, for support and refutation alike
findings.counterexample: read active@t1, attempted set_status@t2 (unproven effect), claim 'status is active' -> pre-audit TRUE
findings.current_behavior: TRUE (support branch had no staleness gate; refute-with-earlier-support branch neither)

findings.invariant: the FRESH_STATE_EVIDENCE closure may only be established by trusted state evidence (pure-reader observations, verified effects); the mutation result's own operation-status row must not establish freshness
findings.counterexample: read active@t1, set_status@suspended@t2 returning {status: SUCCESS}, response claims 'status is active', goal closure supplied -> pre-audit PROVED_NO_ERROR certified (false certified safety)
findings.current_behavior: freshness established via predicate-name matching over ALL observations including mutation envelope rows
findings.corpus_impact: false_certified_NO_ERROR stays 0 on the regression corpora; the adversarial path is closed

findings.invariant: an observation row is entity-bound only within its own JSON object scope (output-path alignment); an envelope field is not the nested entity's state; a scope naming two distinct entities is not attributable
findings.counterexample: pure reader returns {status: SUCCESS, account: {id: A-1, status: pending}}, claim 'account A-1 status is active' -> pre-audit refuted by the top-level envelope row; flat variant {from_account: A-1, to_account: A-2, from_balance: 100} supported a claim anchored to the wrong entity
findings.current_behavior: predicate-name matching + event-level entity refs
findings.correct_behavior: UNKNOWN for both variants (subtree scope + same-scope ambiguity skip)
findings.fixed: partial - nested-envelope and multi-entity variants fixed; flat single-entity envelope is representation-limited (REP-01) and pinned by strict xfail test_B05
findings.corpus_impact: none (corpus results are flat single-entity or search lists whose binding is unchanged or tightened)

findings.invariant: predicate P == value V is NOT equivalent to predicate V == true without a trusted equivalence declaration; the untrusted claim's own value token must never select an evidence channel
findings.counterexample: reader returns {item_id: ITEM-1, red: true}, claim 'color is red' -> pre-audit TRUE via lexical flag channel (and red: false -> FALSE)
findings.current_behavior: flag channel supports/refutes value-anchored claims from same-named boolean predicates
findings.correct_behavior: UNKNOWN; equivalence returns only with explicit semantic_equivalences (REP-02)
findings.corpus_impact: hold-042 PROVED_NO_ERROR->UNRESOLVED (gold_binary None, binary-neutral); documented coverage cost COV-03

findings.invariant: a T1 read is a trusted fresh state observation only when the contract's preconditions held (the same trusted rule evaluate_t1 applies to effects); a failed read's payload is an operation outcome
findings.counterexample: reader contract with preconditions [result.status == SUCCESS]; read fails returning {status: FAILURE, error: timeout}; claim 'status is active' -> pre-audit FALSE (certified ERROR)
findings.current_behavior: no precondition gating for read rows
findings.corpus_impact: none (corpus reader contracts declare empty preconditions)

findings.invariant: refuting a PAST existential requires the complete state timeline (every mutation of the entity, including external actors); history_complete certifies only the completeness of the supplied trace
findings.counterexample: complete trace with reads active@t1, active@t3; external actor set cancelled@t2; claim 'status WAS cancelled' -> pre-audit FALSE
findings.current_behavior: FALSE when rows exist, none support, ledger.history_complete

findings.invariant: authorization alternatives are satisfaction paths only for the requirement they are linked to (frame-level: same action_key or the action_key is one of the alternatives; operational: the rule's bound tool is one of the alternatives); cross-frame authorization is never satisfaction
findings.counterexample: 'Book flight FL-1. Also, cancel hotel H-1 or modify hotel H-1 as needed.' + assistant only calls cancel_hotel -> pre-audit REQUIRE(book_flight) satisfied by the unrelated alternative (false NO_ERROR path)
findings.current_behavior: global union of all GOAL_ALTERNATIVES alternatives extends every REQUIRE rule
findings.corpus_impact: dev-019 UNRESOLVED->PROVED_NO_ERROR (improvement: linkage un-degenerated the alternative-actions case); hold-070/072 preserved

findings.invariant: action-gate prerequisites resolve only from trusted state evidence (pure-reader rows, verified effects); operation rows from uncontracted/mutation tools never resolve a gate
findings.counterexample: gate 'check_booking' (CALL_ATTEMPTED, expected true); uncontracted mutation result {booking: false} -> pre-audit token-overlap row refuted the gate (FALSE)
findings.current_behavior: observation fallback consults all ledger observations
findings.correct_behavior: UNKNOWN (trusted-evidence-only under conservative semantics; B0 keeps frozen behavior)
findings.corpus_impact: none (corpus gates resolve through call matching; B0 fidelity verified)

findings.class: FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_BUG (crash; produces no verdict, never a false definitive)
findings.invariant: goal frames carrying conditions/exceptions must compile (missing 'bound' positional argument raised TypeError)
findings.counterexample: any AUTHORIZATION/DESIRED_OUTCOME frame with non-empty conditions
findings.current_behavior: TypeError; evaluator degrades the case to UNRESOLVED, library call raises
findings.correct_behavior: conditions compile to HISTORY-bound prerequisite atoms
findings.corpus_impact: none (no corpus goal frame carries conditions)

findings.invariant: a tool that writes anything (even an unrelated audit field) is not a pure reader; its reads are discarded (sound abstention)
findings.counterexample: tool reads account.balance, writes audit.last_access
findings.current_behavior: UNKNOWN

findings.invariant: nested business fields (account.status) are distinct predicates from bare claim names (status); no false support/refutation crosses the path boundary
findings.counterexample: claim predicate 'status' vs row predicate 'account.status'
findings.current_behavior: UNKNOWN (coverage loss, sound direction)

findings.invariant: cost of the SND-04 soundness fix: flag-encoded claims verify only when the claim predicate IS the boolean field (direct predicate channel)
findings.counterexample: hold-042 shape: claim (status, cancelled) + effect (cancelled, true) -> UNKNOWN
findings.current_behavior: UNKNOWN
findings.counterexample_test: tests/e2e/test_e2e_v1_cycle3.py::test_lexical_flag_channel_removed_value_anchored_claim_unknown (companion sound path: test_C03 direct-predicate flag claims)

findings.invariant: state gates resolve only against boolean-typed rows whose predicate overlaps the gate key tokens; everything else stays UNKNOWN
findings.counterexample: gate 'account_status' vs string-valued row 'status'
findings.current_behavior: UNKNOWN (conservative)

findings.invariant: field-level read contracts (output_path, entity_ref, predicate, freshness per read) are required to close the flat single-entity envelope risk
findings.counterexample: flat reader {account_id: A-1, status: SUCCESS} where top-level status is an operation envelope - indistinguishable from a business field
findings.current_behavior: envelope row can refute state claims (the ONE known open formal soundness risk)
findings.correct_behavior: T1 reads: [{output_path: status, entity_ref: arguments.account_id, predicate: status, freshness: fresh}] in V2; cannot be retrofitted to the frozen corpus
findings.counterexample_test: test_B05_flat_envelope_row_never_refutes (strict xfail documenting the open risk)
findings.corpus_impact: none on corpus (corpus readers return business fields at top level)

findings.invariant: explicit semantic_equivalences declarations for enum<->flag encodings (the sound replacement for the removed lexical flag channel)
findings.counterexample: SND-04's counterexample re-enabled safely
findings.current_behavior: not representable
findings.correct_behavior: semantic_equivalences: [{lhs: {predicate: status, value: cancelled}, rhs: {predicate: cancelled, value: true}}]

findings.invariant: contract-declared canonicalization for cross-type literal comparison (hardening of EMP-01)
findings.counterexample: schema-declared integer canonicalization would make '42'<->42 comparable by declaration
findings.current_behavior: declared adapter canonical-encoding convention (EMP-01)
findings.counterexample_test: tests D01-D04 pin both the safe and convention behaviors

findings.invariant: mixed freshness within one output (fresh balance, cached monthly_summary) is not expressible; while T1 is trusted this is a contract-authoring risk, not a proof error
findings.counterexample: {balance: 100, monthly_summary: 4250} with tool-level fresh-read
findings.current_behavior: all fields treated fresh per the trusted contract

findings.invariant: T1 must characterize consistency/freshness; a trusted fresh-read contract is taken at face value, so replica staleness is outside Guardian's proof scope
findings.counterexample: write committed, immediate replica read returns old state
findings.current_behavior: trusted contract vouches the read

findings.invariant: machine-readable success/failure semantics for read contracts; SND-05's precondition gate is the best available proxy
findings.counterexample: contract without preconditions + failed read still emits rows
findings.current_behavior: precondition-gated when declared; otherwise envelope risk remains (shares REP-01 residue)

findings.invariant: accepted/queued/scheduled/started/completed must stay distinct literals (no collapse); V1 keeps them distinct by value identity
findings.counterexample: start_export -> accepted=true; claim 'completed' refuted (correct)
findings.current_behavior: distinct literals stay distinct (test G01 pins it)
findings.correct_behavior: stage semantics via contracts in V2

findings.invariant: a desired outcome with no target calls is vacuously satisfied (authorization is not obligation); unfulfilled-goal detection relies on OBLIGATION frames and the claim axis
findings.counterexample: goal unfulfilled + non-committal response -> NO_ERROR possible
findings.current_behavior: declared V1 program-space limitation (documented in module docstrings)

findings.invariant: the canonical-encoding literal coercion (claim text token == canonical JSON encoding of the observed number/boolean) is a declared, deterministic, total adapter convention; no counterexample constructible without unrepresentable text-type distinctions; leading-zero/precision-distinct literals already UNKNOWN
findings.counterexample: claim '42' vs observation 42 -> TRUE under the convention; '001' vs 1 -> UNKNOWN (pinned)
findings.current_behavior: kept as declared convention
findings.correct_behavior: harden with REP-03 declarations in V2

findings.invariant: lexical token bridging for state gates (gate 'account_status' <- trusted row 'status') remains on trusted rows for B0-frozen compatibility; corpus-neutral; exact-predicate gates recommended in V2
findings.counterexample: boolean trusted row whose predicate is a token of the gate key resolves the gate
findings.current_behavior: kept (B0-shared)

findings.invariant: entity refs are extracted only from id/_id/name keys; other key conventions (from_account/to_account) bind no entity refs - claims stay unbound (marker), conservative
findings.counterexample: {from_account, to_account, from_balance} -> no entity refs at all
findings.current_behavior: conservative unbinding
findings.correct_behavior: broader conventions are a V2 representation question

findings.invariant: machine suffixes (POLICY_ATOM_CATALOG, POLICY_STATE_CONSTRAINTS) make atom keys and trusted literals textually groundable for the operational binding; the frontends parse the RAW policy text; the suffix influences grounding, not normative meaning; recorded as an architectural risk per directive section 30
findings.counterexample: a binding candidate quoting machine metadata verbatim (validated against the extended text by design - grounding context, not normative rule)
findings.current_behavior: grounding-only in every audited path
findings.correct_behavior: keep; the risk is that a future frontend interprets suffix text normatively - guarded by the raw-text parse boundary

findings.invariant: PROVED means PROVED FROM EXPLICIT TRUSTED PREMISES: a flat root-scope result field next to an entity ref key carries no trusted premise that it is entity STATE rather than an operation envelope field, so ownership cannot be proved and the row must not decide a state claim (abstain -> UNKNOWN)
findings.counterexample: T1 pure reader (writes=(), fresh-read, preconditions ok) returns {'account_id': 'A-1', 'status': 'SUCCESS'} where status is the operation envelope; claim 'status of A-1 is active' was refuted by the envelope row -> certified PROVED_ERROR (false definitive from wrong field mapping)
findings.current_behavior_pre_fix: PROVED_ERROR certified from the flat envelope row
findings.correct_behavior: UNKNOWN / UNRESOLVED unless the T1 contract declares the output path in `reads` (explicit ownership mapping) or the row lives in a nested record object with the entity ref (structural ownership)
findings.fix: root-scope abstention + explicit ownership mapping via the existing T1 `reads` field (previously dead weight); applied identically to the state channel and the SND-09 gate fallback; gated behind conservative_state so B0 keeps byte fidelity
